Frontend.reason: The Tracker vocabulary-center AI dialog no longer requests AI when opened and restores a 24-hour account-and-plan-scoped session draft. Tracker now batch-loads the newest short-lived Words decision for vocabulary plans, displays pending, accepted, rejected or expired status in Vocabulary Center and Plan Center, refreshes after a send or browser return without polling, and keeps account-binding checks before correlating local plan IDs.

Backend.reason: A backward-compatible owner-scoped RPC returns only the newest compact plan-intent row for at most 50 requested source references. It reuses the existing capped handoff table, adds no table, column, index, snapshot or learning copy, retains terminal decisions for seven days, and preserves direct-table revocation plus authenticated-account checks.

Admin.reason: Reviewed Lexi Control and its admin RPC boundaries. Plan receipts are transient owner-only workflow feedback with no policy, quota, moderation, support or remotely manageable value; granting administrators a new read path would expose learner workflow without an operational action, so no Control surface is added.

Deployment.reason: Local coordinated release candidate only. The new Supabase migration, Words release unit and Tracker frontend have not been pushed, applied or deployed; production remains unchanged.

Verification.reason: The complete Tracker release gate passed typecheck, lint, 85 test files and 520 tests, production build and bundle checks. The coordinated Words release gate also passed learner, Control and Account builds plus all migration, RLS, account-isolation, sync, AI and security regressions. Browser acceptance confirmed pending and accepted receipt states, accurate copy, no console errors, and no dialog-level horizontal overflow at a mobile-class viewport.
